We need to compare days. 21 calendar days vs 14 business days. Business days vs calendar days. We need to interpret fastest delivery. Usually business days are more efficient. But we need to decide. We can convert: 21 calendar days ~ 15 business days (assuming 5 business days per week). But we don't know. Might treat as 21 days. But we can note that BrightPath has 21 calendar days, which is longer than 14 business days. So BrightPath slower.

Nimbus: Total delivered price 36,700.00. Delivery lead time 7 business days.

Orbital: Total delivered price 36,480.00. Delivery lead time 10 business days.

Thus lowest price: BrightPath 35,750.00. Fastest delivery: Nimbus 7 business days.
